name: OT cybersecurity
principle: Operational technology (DCS, SCADA, PLC) has been shown vulnerable to attack; defence in depth, patching, segmentation and secure remote access are the main measures.

Segment networks and control remote access

gaps.item: IEC 62443 requirements and oil and gas incidents
gaps.reason: Not in the pages read. IEC 62443 (industrial automation and control systems security) defines the security levels and requirements; incident context: Stuxnet (2010, uranium enrichment) and the Colonial Pipeline ransomware (2021) are the canonical O&G-adjacent cases; 2026-10-28.
gaps.action: Add the standard and incident references.
